evidence.reason: The current `_timer_schedule_seconds` still computes the overall bound only from `OnCalendar`/`OnUnitActiveSec`/`OnUnitInactiveSec` intervals plus `AccuracySec`. It never reads `RandomizedDelaySec`, which systemd applies on top of timer elapse and can delay the next activation. A timer template declaring `RandomizedDelaySec=` is therefore under-bounded, allowing preflight to admit a deadline that systemd can exceed.
